episodes.synopsis: Aoi once made a promise, but to whom? That person’s name — and the ambition it inspires — is on the tip of her tongue… and on the top of a distant peak!
episodes.title: 1st Season: Spring

episodes.synopsis: Mt. Fuji awaits! What will Aoi and her friends see from that legendary summit? The peak is in reach... but will they all make it to the top?
episodes.title: 2nd Season: Summer Part 1

episodes.synopsis: Think you can’t climb a mountain in Tokyo? Think again! The Success Steps of the Atago Shrine are right around the corner.
episodes.title: 2nd Season: Summer Part 2

episodes.synopsis: Their next thrilling summit isn’t a mountain. It’s the king of the coasters, and they’re going to conquer this peak, too!
episodes.title: 3rd Season: Fall

episodes.synopsis: The mountaineering club is a lot of fun, but not everyone was into the idea at first glance. Some people need a more comprehensive introduction!
episodes.title: A Challenge From the Mountaineering Club!? / Tough Love on Mt. Buko?

episodes.synopsis: A trip to Naguri Lake? Sounds like fun, especially since Aoi gets to try canoeing with her coworker. But does this outing feel a bit…unusual?
episodes.title: Hikari’s Big Date Plans! / Together for a White Christmas!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata, Kokona and Aoi plan to watch the first sunrise from atop Mt. Tenranzan, but the plan may change on a dime when they get unexpected news!
episodes.title: Where to Watch the First Sunrise / Hiking With Classmates!

episodes.synopsis: With Valentine’s Day approaching, Aoi and the girls invite Honoka out to hike Mt. Mitake in Okutama.
episodes.title: Power Spot for Valentine’s Day? / Trying Out Snowshoes!

episodes.synopsis: Learning to fish is fun… or at least it should be. So why does it feel like Kokona’s mind is miles away from the day’s activities at Naguri stream?
episodes.title: Mountain Stream Fishing – The Meaning of Life? / Off to Kamakura With Hinata’s Family!

episodes.synopsis: A spur-of-the-moment proposal snowballs into Aoi leading her entire class on a hike! Somehow this feels more like herding cats than a game of “follow the leader,” though…
episodes.title: A New Season

episodes.synopsis: After her last attempt, it’s time for Aoi to scale Mount Fuji once again. But she isn’t climbing alone, and her plans will need to make her friends happy, too.
episodes.title: We Meet Again, Mount Fuji!

episodes.synopsis: The girls head up the Subashiri Trail despite fears about the weather, and things seem to go smoothly! But past is all too often prologue, and Hinata must make a big decision…
episodes.title: Onward! To a New Summit
